children: Cintas certified compliance with U.S. and Canadian regulator requests and expects the UniFirst mergers to close in 2026.
Cintas and UniFirst certified substantial compliance with the FTC Second Request on Oct. 2, 2026, and entered a timing agreement with the FTC.
Under the timing agreement, the parties agreed not to close the mergers before Dec. 11, 2026 unless the FTC closes its investigation earlier in writing.
Cintas and UniFirst completed responses to the Canadian Competition Bureau’s Supplementary Information Request on Sept. 29, 2026.
Cintas continues to expect the mergers to close before the end of calendar year 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory clearances.
